correspondence.finding: Same ID, compute/G6/assignment metadata, input/output slots, fn address; run calls ctx.span, reads scoredPairs, invokes actual imported rankPairsByBadge once, writes Map, stops span. No feature resolve or image read in that operation.
Same grouping by first badge appearance, descending score then supportMean then pairId.localeCompare, cloned row with rank index+1; raw/factors preserved by spread. No copied consumer algorithm.
Both derive exported universe, actual implementation map and calculation binding map from the same registered OperationDefs.

Same runtime lookup, body hashing/binding order check, tracked operation call, Promise rejection, conformance, post-call extractor invocation, sink.putArtifact, Receipt and sink.putReceipt. No difference found in scoped behavior.
Both include only Array or ArrayBuffer-view lengths; Map not included.
Both hash emitted bytes, store artifact refs and bytes under ID, use memory://ID URI, and collect receipts. Null sink returns empty hashes and must not be used for the bridge.

Both freeze op ID, bound calculation identity, actual accesses, writes and artifact {id,kind,sha256,dims}; probes, timing and opaque board output values are omitted. Both explicitly disclose tick-testimony-and-materializations scope. Baseline A/B identity equality under synthetic fixed params is a documented limitation, not a core bug.
Same board Map API, missing-read error, tracked accesses and new-address/refinement/replacement write classification.
Same no-op span returns stop function; ranking only uses span. Module initializes an OcclusionDetector at load, already in static closure.
Same recursive key sorting, array-order preservation and undefined object-value omission. The async WebCrypto sha256 export exists but the sync PCR route uses exec/sha256, not it.

limitations: This text scanner is not a full JavaScript parser. All discovered calls were literal local requires; no missing or external edge was found, but runtime import remains a separate unperformed gate.
Manual correspondence covers the exact protocol-relevant behaviors listed, not proof that all dist files were freshly compiled from all source files.
No Node producer imports, tests, native/CV/image/pixel/decode work, network, installs, rebuilds, or native/canonical receipt writes occurred. Only owned S3/E4408 scratch artifacts were written.

If a later authorized import fails due to module resolution, top-level initialization, assets, or another dependency, stop and report the first error; this audit is not authorization to install/rebuild/patch/substitute.
